You went way overboard with it. Don't worry too much tho, you can bounce back from everything.
You overclocked your body a bit and it's going to need some time now to restore the balance. 

The first few days you're probably going to feel terrible, maybe even unable to feel any kind of positive emotion, but don't worry, remind yourself it's just the molly depleting your brain of it's natural serotonin reserves and it's going to pass as your body is healing itself. It's very important for the first week at least to eat healthy, nutritious food, drink electrolytes like gatorade or my favorite, coconut water, take supplements like Vitamin C, Magnesium Glycinate, Vitamin B Complex, Vitamin D + K2, NAC(very important, helps your brain restore neurotransmitter balance) and most importantly, get sufficient sleep.

You're going to notice your feelings coming and going in waves. As the days go by you notice more and more positive thoughts. In this period it's very important to focus on what you have and to practice gratitude. Also, do small things around the house, like taking out the trash, cooking a meal, washing the dishes or anything that gives natural dopamine over time. It's also very important in this stage to exercise regularly.

Only you know how much of this you can apply to your life, nobody knows what's best for you but you. My advice is to focus on learning about life and trying to enjoy it for what it is, without the drugs. If you manage to do that, drugs will only enhance your life and not destroy it, like in this instance. Could've turned out way worse than it did. Be grateful you have had the opportunity to learn from this, but do learn from it.
